quote: The kitchen states it uses no chemical seasonings and makes its own sauce and noodles in-house, so ingredient sourcing is unusually transparent.

note: All three factual halves are verbatim on the cited page. The inference bolted onto the end — 'so ingredient sourcing is unusually transparent' — does not follow and is mildly dangerous in a GF/vegan app: 化学調味料不使用 is an MSG claim, not an allergen claim, and the page gives no allergen information at all. The in-house production actually cuts the other way for a celiac (the noodles are made by the shop itself from wheat) and for a vegan (the in-house sauce contains oyster). Recommend rewording to state the facts without the transparency conclusion. Trading status OK: そぞ is currently listed in the ひろしまお好み物語 駅前ひろば tenant directory, hours 10:30-23:00 (L.O. 22:30), 年中無休.
